title: Summer Vegetable Lasagne
subtitle: with zucchini, eggplant and bechamel
description: Layers of pasta sheets, a finely diced zucchini, eggplant and carrot vegetable mix and olive oil bechamel, baked until golden under parmesan.

steps.text: Cook the pasta sheets in a large pot of boiling water. Cool in a bowl of iced water, then lay out on 3 towels to dry.
Heat some of the olive oil in a pot and soften the finely diced onion for 3 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini, eggplant, carrot and garlic, pour in boiling water to cover and cook over high heat until all the water evaporates. Season with salt and pepper and cool.

For the bechamel, heat 6 tbsp olive oil in a pot, whisk in the flour, then pour in the cold milk all at once, whisking until smooth. Bring to the boil and cook for 3 minutes, stirring, to a fairly loose sauce. Season with half the parmesan, salt, white pepper and a little grated nutmeg. Cool, stirring occasionally.
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Spread a thin layer of bechamel in a 30 x 22 cm deep dish and cover with pasta sheets.
Spread another thin layer of bechamel, then a thin layer of the vegetables. Repeat to make 6 layers of pasta, bechamel and vegetables. Sprinkle the remaining parmesan on top.
